2607.11346.title: Compile, Then Page: Executable SOP Programs and a Capability-Gated Runtime for Procedural LLM Agents
2607.11346.paper_summary: Enterprise agents must follow long-horizon, conditional, safety-critical standard operating procedures (SOPs). We compile machine-readable SOP constraints into executable pseudo-code and run them with a program-guided (PG) stack machine that pages the active frame while an LLM performs semantic execution. A three-arm SOPBench study across six models separates representation from runtime: compiled text never significantly hurts and gains up to 16.0 points where official prose underperforms. Runtime guidance is capability-gated. Two strong models independently show positive seven-domain PG contrasts (58:19 and 75:31 discordant pairs), whereas weak models are harmed. A full-program cursor ablation (active frame first, complete program retained) recovers much of the strong-model refusal gain; selective visibility adds a smaller improvement. Paired probe and audit measurements track this divide to spontaneous state discipline rather than reconstruction ability. On Bank the three primary arms rise from 70.4 to 86.4 to 92.8, with 100% refusal correctness. Practical guidance: compile first; enable active-frame paging only after a model-level discipline check.
2607.11346.paper_summary_zh: 企業代理必須遵循長期、條件性、安全關鍵的標準作業程序（SOP）。我們將機器可讀的SOP約束編譯成可執行的偽代碼，並使用程序引導（PG）堆疊機運行它們，當大型語言模型（LLM）執行語義時，該堆疊機會翻頁活動幀。跨六個模型的三臂SOPBench研究將表示與運行時分開：編譯的文本從未顯著受損，並在官方散文表現不佳的地方獲得最多16.0分。運行時指導是能力限制的。兩個強模型獨立顯示出正面的七領域PG對比（58:19和75:31不和諧對），而弱模型則受到損害。全面程序光標消融（首先是活動幀，保留完整程序）恢復了強模型拒絕增益的許多部分；選擇性可見性則帶來較小的改善。配對探測和審計測量追蹤這一區別，指向自發狀態紀律而非重建能力。在Bank上，三個主要臂從70.4上升到86.4，再到92.8，拒絕正確率達100%。實用指導：先編譯；僅在模型級紀律檢查後啟用活動幀翻頁。
